notes.title: Welcome to the major update of "The Green Room Experiment: Episode 1"!
notes.content:
New features:

[b]Dream Map :[/b] Explore the depths of your dreams with the brand-new Dream Map. This new feature allows you to instantly locate yourself in the game and revisit your favorite levels once the main experience is completed.

[b]Harmonized Controls :[/b] Enjoy a seamless transition between episodes with the harmonization of controls from Episode 1 to Episode 2. Immerse yourself in the world of "The Green Room Experiment" without interruption, mastering the controls from the get-go.

[b]Enhanced Puzzles :[/b] Some puzzles have been reworked to provide a more enriching and immersive experience. Expect novel challenges that will test your ingenuity.

[b]Persistent Green Button :[/b] The iconic green button remains a constant, allowing you to move on to the next puzzle if you find yourself stuck.

[b]Removal of Bonus Level :[/b] Episode 1 bids farewell to the hospital bonus level, making room for a more substantial free spin-off episode set to release in 2024. Dive into an exclusive story that will reveal more about the dreamers and their fascinating world.

[b]Graphic and Fluidity Improvements :[/b] Enjoy an enhanced aesthetic and smoother gameplay thanks to graphic updates and technical adjustments.

This update aims to create an even more immersive and coherent gaming experience within the dreamy universe of "The Green Room Experiment." Thank you for being part of this adventure.

notes.title: March 2, 2023 Update Notes
notes.content:
A new level has been added to close the adventure and reveal more information about the story of Alexiev Leonid, the dreamer you play during the game.

The player will be immersed in a 1950s Soviet psychiatric hospital under a violent thunderstorm and pouring rain.


New features :

Easter Eggs are hidden in 4 levels and, once revealed, give access to the breakthrough bonus level described. Free access to all levels once the game is over, making it easier to find Easter Eggs, among other things.


A new menu:

An “option” menu redesigned, giving access to more settings, such as full screen or windowed mode or the screen resolution scale.

The success menu to discover their progress and have access to new features (bonus level and free access to all levels).


Help :

Some helpers have been added in the most difficult levels.


Good game everyone,


The Green Room Experiment team
